What's for dinner?It's 5 o'clock again, nothing is thawed, and the drive-thru is calling your name.
The laundry never endsBaskets on the couch, a sink full of dishes, and a house that's messy again by bedtime.

Holidays sneak up on youChristmas, Easter, and back to school arrive in a last-minute scramble that costs more than it should.
Running on emptyNo time to move, no water, no rest, and you can't remember the last time you did something for you.

“Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.”MATTHEW 11:28 (KJV)
No more decision fatigue

What if every day was already planned for you?

The 2027 Peace-Filled Mama Planner carries the load with you. Every page is completely filled in: dinner is chosen, chores are assigned, holiday prep shows up a month early, and your scripture and prayer are waiting each morning. You simply open it, follow the plan, and pour your energy into your family and your walk with Jesus.

“Let all things be done decently and in order.”1 CORINTHIANS 14:40 (KJV)
Inside every day

Everything you need, done for you

Daily Scripture & Prayer

A verse and a written prayer for all 365 days, plus a daily word of encouragement.

Dinner Planned Nightly

A simple weekly meal rhythm with every dinner chosen for you. Tap any dinner to open its full recipe.

Chores & Laundry

Light, doable daily chores and a laundry rotation, so the house never gets away from you.

Homemaking & Self Reliance

A Saturday homemaking task every week: canning, preserving, scratch cooking, gardening, and emergency prep.

Holidays Planned Ahead

Every major holiday has its prep on your list a month early, with a Christ-centered plan to follow.

Budget Check-Ins

A Sunday budget check-in every week, plus a digital Notion budget dashboard you can open from the page.

Gentle Daily Movement

One simple activity each day, 10 to 20 minutes at home, with a quick check to mark that you moved.

Water & Wellness

Eight cups to fill in every day, and a self love reminder that points you back to who you are in Christ.

Gratitude & Priorities

Space each day for your top three priorities and three things you're grateful for.

From one mama to another

I've lived the chaos, the burnout, and the feeling that no matter how hard I worked, I was always letting someone down. I worked multiple jobs and missed moments with my children I'll never get back. But Jesus stepped into my mess and reminded me that peace is possible. Order is possible. Joy is possible.

I created this planner for the mama who is exhausted, who feels behind, and who silently asks God how to keep going. It's not just a planner. It's a soft place to land and a step toward restoring your home, your rhythm, and your relationship with Christ.

Questions

Frequently asked

When will the planner be ready?

The 2027 Peace-Filled Mama Planner releases in December 2026, in time for Christmas gifts and a fresh start on January 1. When you reserve your set, you'll be among the first to know the moment it's ready.

Does reserving cost anything?

No. Reserving simply holds your place on the list. I'll personally reach out with ordering details before release.

Can I buy just one volume?

The planner is sold as a set, so you have your whole year planned from January through December.

Do I have to fill anything in?

Only if you want to. Scripture, prayers, dinners, chores, laundry, movement, homemaking tasks, and holiday prep are already written in. You add your priorities, gratitude, and notes.

How do the clickable recipes and budget dashboard work?

Each dinner links to its full recipe online, and each Sunday links to a digital Notion budget dashboard. A QR code inside the planner opens the dashboard from your phone.

Is it a good gift?

It's a beautiful gift for a busy mama, a new mom, or a friend who needs peace in her home this year.
